title: AutoDev Pixel Animation Manifest
description: Runtime-agnostic description of a pixel animation. The sprite sheet holds ONLY frame images; everything about how the animation plays (order, timing, motion, events, loop, priority) lives here so the same art can be driven differently by different runtimes.

spriteSheet.description: Relative path to the sprite-sheet PNG that contains every frame image.

frameWidth.description: Width of a single frame in pixels (default 64).

frameHeight.description: Height of a single frame in pixels (default 32).

columns.description: Number of frame columns in the sprite sheet.

rows.description: Number of frame rows in the sprite sheet.

loop.description: Whether playback repeats after the last frame.

priority.description: Higher wins when two animations compete for the same sprite. Advisory to the runtime.

interruptible.description: Whether a higher-priority animation may cut this one off mid-play.

frames.description: Ordered playlist. Each entry references a cell of the sprite sheet by index and gives its on-screen duration. The array order IS the play order; the same index may appear more than once.

index.description: Zero-based frame index into the sprite sheet (row-major).

durationMs.description: How long this frame is shown, in milliseconds.

motion.description: Keyframed transform of the WHOLE sprite over time (tween). The runtime interpolates between successive keyframes using each keyframe's easing. Independent of the frame flip-book.

events.description: Timeline events fired at the given time offset (sound cue, particle/effect, gameplay callback, ...).
